[Thinking]
**Explaining core inflation data retrieval**

I need to find the year-over-year (YoY) core inflation data for the US from January 2015 to December 2016, likely focusing on Core CPI YoY. However, I can't access web data beyond 2024. I realize I can't memorize monthly series, so I should explain this limitation to the user. Providing accurate numbers is crucial, so I can guide them on how to obtain this data from sources like BLS or FRED. I'll create a markdown table with a placeholder column for the missing data.
[/Thinking]

I don’t have reliable access to the exact month‑by‑month U.S. core inflation series (year‑over‑year) for Jan 2015–Dec 2016 from here, so I shouldn’t fabricate the numbers.

However, you can get the precise values from FRED/BLS and then use the table format below to plug them in.

### How to get the data

1. Go to the St. Louis Fed FRED site:  
   https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPILFESL  
   (Series: “Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items Less Food and Energy in U.S. City Average” – this is the standard “core CPI.”)

2. On the series page:
   - Click “Download” (top right).
   - Choose the date range 2015‑01‑01 to 2016‑12‑31.
   - Download as Excel or CSV.

3. In Excel (or similar), compute the year‑over‑year percentage change for each month:
   \[
   \text{Core CPI YoY (\%)}_t = \frac{\text{Index}_t - \text{Index}_{t-12}}{\text{Index}_{t-12}} \times 100
   \]

4. Fill the values into the table below.

### Markdown table template

```markdown
| Month      | Core CPI YoY (%) |
|-----------:|------------------|
| 2015-01    |                  |
| 2015-02    |                  |
| 2015-03    |                  |
| 2015-04    |                  |
| 2015-05    |                  |
| 2015-06    |                  |
| 2015-07    |                  |
| 2015-08    |                  |
| 2015-09    |                  |
| 2015-10    |                  |
| 2015-11    |                  |
| 2015-12    |                  |
| 2016-01    |                  |
| 2016-02    |                  |
| 2016-03    |                  |
| 2016-04    |                  |
| 2016-05    |                  |
| 2016-06    |                  |
| 2016-07    |                  |
| 2016-08    |                  |
| 2016-09    |                  |
| 2016-10    |                  |
| 2016-11    |                  |
| 2016-12    |                  |
```

If you’d like, you can paste the downloaded data (or a few rows of it) here, and I can compute and format the YoY core inflation rates into this table for you.
